'''yodaindahouze This is some Rescue...''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[yodaindahouze]]
* '''Published:''' 17 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rescue The Princess|SE-L-rescuetheprincess.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Rescue The Princess
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 RTP yodaindahouze LS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

the rescue of the princess. this deck is fun and can take you back to the days of fighting on the death star. just don't fall down the garbage chute.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

this is probably the deck that is the most intricate for me to work. The idea is to get out 8D8 and 2 lift tubes. if you can get a 4 or more destiny then you can get leia on yavin 4 in one turn.

1. play 8D8 on yavin4:db
2. lift tubes at docking 327 and detention
corridor
3. 8D8 transits, then moves using the lift tube
4. if you draw 4 or more destiny, leia moves in lift tube to db327 and transits to yavin4:db

that leaves one turn to get her to the war room so use it to (1) protect her and (2) get guys out to take down the opposition. this deck is also sweet because of the bothans and ds plans. they can get you at least 10 force, sometimes more. the advantages the objective gives you are definitely worth the trouble of rescuing the princess.
please rate. thanks.
